tool.name: Label Overlaps
tool.description: Compute label overlap statistics from two label images.
tool.help:
This tool computes label overlap statistics between two label images using SimpleITK.
**Inputs** - Label image 1 (e.g., .nii, .nii.gz, .mha, .nrrd, .tif) - Label image 2 (same size as label image 1)
**Output** A CSV file with columns:
| image1 | image2 | label1 | label2 | overlap | |--------|--------|--------|--------|---------|
Where `overlap` is the number of voxels where label1 equals `label1` and label2 equals `label2`.
